about: X-Plane 12 rendering constants by art-control name (plan REQ-001, GUD-002). Each entry: value and where it came from. X-Plane names carry X-Plane's values as the reference probe dumped them; sedx/* are SEDX's own controls. Exposure tables (photometric/ev100_mid and ev100_bias by sun elevation) are fitted in renderer/exposure.h.

lighting/scenery_ref_nts.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): luminance of a white LIT texel with no ATTR_LIT_LEVEL (xp_object.cpp)

autoexposure/gain_lo.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): share of a reading below ev100_mid the exposure takes (fits the one genuine auto readout: EV 4.31 at sun -12 deg)

autoexposure/gain_hi.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): share of a reading above ev100_mid

autoexposure/_exp_radius.source: ASSUMPTION: centre-weight radius in screen heights

exposure_fusion/max_mip.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): SEDX clamps to its 5-level pyramid

atmo/ozone_width.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): m, full width of the tent

atmo/fog_albedo.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): scattering albedo of the visibility fog

sedx/fog_start_visibility_m.source: SEDX, from X-Plane 12.4.4's stats/scattering/est_view_vis_fog (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): FLT_MAX (no fog) at 20, 30 and 80 km visibility, where X-Plane only thickens its Mie. The visibility's layer has no fog at this visibility and more

sedx/fog_full_visibility_m.source: SEDX calibration (2026-10-26): the clean *_aerial_hazy shots (8 km) match with the whole layer as fog (luminance within 0.2 EV, the veil's colour); ASSUMPTION: linear from fog_start_visibility_m. X-Plane's own fog sees 14,488 m from 600 m up there, so its layer thins with height faster than SEDX's

sedx/sun_tint_red.source: SEDX calibration (2026-10-26) against the 15 X-Plane 12.4.4 *_rwy_sunp40 shots: the sun's red over green on environment/sky_light.h SUN_COLOR, at the same luminance. X-Plane's runway paint (RUNWAY_MARKINGS 1 1 1, the same white in both) came out 6% redder than SEDX's (log2 r/g -0.07 on screen, about 11% in scene-linear light); with this and haze_mie_scale the paint is within -0.01 and the sky's blue within 0.03 in the upper bands. X-Plane doesn't show its u_E_sun colour

sedx/sun_tint_blue.source: SEDX calibration (2026-10-26), with sun_tint_red: the sun's blue over green on SUN_COLOR, at the same luminance

sedx/haze_mie_scale.source: SEDX calibration (2026-10-26), with sun_tint_red: X-Plane 12.4.4's 80 km runway skies are bluer than the whole visibility deficit as extra Mie gives (upper sky b/g -0.08, then 0.00 with 0.55; 0.32 overshoots, +0.07, and darkens the upper sky). On the extra Mie only, so the fog of short visibilities (fog_full_visibility_m and less) keeps its calibration

scattering/mie_scattering_exponent.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): Angstrom exponent; _absorption_exponent is the same

scattering/vis_cutoff_ratio.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): visibility = distance to 1% contrast: extinction 4.605 / V

reno/rcas_rat.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): FSR 1 RCAS scale

color_management/sdr/slope_red.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): the day grade (where middle grey lands, per channel)

color_management/sdr/slope_green.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): the day grade (where middle grey lands, per channel)

color_management/sdr/slope_blue.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): the day grade (where middle grey lands, per channel)

color_management/sdr/power_red.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): the day grade, the contrast around middle grey in scene linear (155 of 195 shots; 1.44 / 1.44 / 1.5408 with snow on the ground, 1 at night)

color_management/compression.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): the display curve's working space, read as each channel keeping 1 - c of itself and taking c of the luminance (ASSUMPTION about the construction; abney_correction 1.22 is not applied)

shadow/csm/lambda.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): 1 = logarithmic cascade splits

shadow/overlap_ratio.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): share of a cascade's depth it blends into the next over

sedx/meter_trim_lo.source: SEDX metering: histogram fraction below which nothing meters (reads within 0.3 EV of X-Plane's photometric/ev100_mtr in clear daylight and at night)

sedx/meter_trim_hi.source: SEDX metering: histogram fraction above which nothing meters

sedx/exposure_compensation.source: SEDX: EV on top of the automatic exposure, positive brightens

sedx/fusion_shadows_ev.source: ASSUMPTION: EV the exposure fusion lifts the shadows by (X-Plane exposure_fusion/shadows is an adaptive readout, 0.2 in daylight)

sedx/fusion_sigma.source: Mertens et al. 2007 well-exposedness width, as in Wronski 2022 (X-Plane exposure_fusion/sigma 5.5 means something else)

sedx/fusion_highlights_ev.source: ASSUMPTION: EV the exposure fusion lowers the highlights by

sedx/bloom_intensity.source: ASSUMPTION: share of the bloom chain in the frame (X-Plane hdr/bloom1 -5.9, bloom_exponent 1.51 not mapped yet)

sedx/aerial_range_m.source: aerial perspective volume depth (X-Plane scattering/cache_distance_max 250 km, 25 km in fog)

sedx/airglow_nits.source: ASSUMPTION: moonless night sky, about 22 mag/arcsec^2

sedx/star_brightness.source: procedural stars: 1 = catalogue magnitudes (X-Plane stars/gain_photometric 20 not mapped)

shadow/csm_split_exterior.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): sun-shadow cascades; the shadow quality level sets it (renopt_shadow_quality)

shadow/csm/near_limit_exterior.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): m, where the split scheme starts (the first cascade still starts at the camera)

shadow/csm/far_limit_exterior.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): m of view depth; the shadow quality level sets it

shadow/total_fade_ratio.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): shadows fade out from this share of the far limit (ASSUMPTION about its meaning); the shadow quality level sets it

shadow/csm/pad_near_const.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): m the near plane moves toward the light

shadow/csm/pad_near_ratio.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): plus this share of the cascade's radius (ASSUMPTION: radius, not diameter)

fbo/shadow_cam_size.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): shadow-map size; the shadow quality level sets it

shadow/bias_const.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): constant depth bias on the casters, in depth units (read as polygon-offset units)

shadow/bias_slope.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): slope-scaled depth bias on the casters (read as polygon-offset slope factor)

shadow/bias_n_constant.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): receiver normal offset, texels

shadow/bias_n_slope.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): receiver normal offset per unit of tan(angle to the light), texels

shadow/want_soft.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): 3 x 3 filtered lookups

clouds/cloud_shadow_lighten_ratio.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): read as the share of the light clouds can take away (ASSUMPTION)

cloud/shadow_alpha.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): read as extinction per meter of cloud cover along the light (ASSUMPTION)

clouds/shadow_extent_min_km.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): the first cloud-shadow cascade's width

clouds/shadow_extent_km.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): the last cloud-shadow cascade's width

ssao/radius.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): m, view space; with ssao/dynamic_values X-Plane wrote 2.1 at 2-8 m above the ground and 22 at 600 m (renderer/cacao.h scales it with the height)

ssao/shadow_multiplier.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): CACAO's shadowMultiplier (x 4.3 in the shaders)

ssao/fade_in_from.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): m, X-Plane's own fade near the camera (not in AMD's CACAO)

ssao/fade_in_to.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): m; 100 at 600 m above the ground (dynamic values)

ssao/adaptive_quality_limit.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): CACAO highest only

ssao/exterior_strength.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): applied as lerp(1, ao ^ curve, strength) (ASSUMPTION; identity at these values)

ssao/dynamic_values.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): radius and fade-in follow the camera's height above the ground

sedx/csm_receiver_plane.source: SEDX: soft shadow lookups compare against the receiver's plane (from the depth buffer), so the casters' slope bias covers half a texel each way. With X-Plane's shadow/bias_slope 2 alone, the calibration panels 5 cm above the ground lose their shadow at cascade 1's 4 cm texels; X-Plane 12.4.4's reference keeps a 12 cm band.

sedx/csm_receiver_plane_slope_bias.source: SEDX: the casters' slope-scaled depth bias with the receiver plane on (half a texel each way of the 2 x 2 gathers)

sedx/csm_height_near_ratio.source: ASSUMPTION: the cascades split from at least 0.8 x the camera height above the airport (the ground starts no nearer from above)

sedx/csm_height_far_ratio.source: ASSUMPTION fitted to X-Plane 12.4.4 references (2026-10-25): at 600 m up its shadows reach about 3 km though shadow/csm/far_limit_exterior stays 250

ssr/min_gloss.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): surfaces less glossy (gloss = (1 - roughness) / 0.96875) keep the probes' reflections alone

ssr/lod_bias.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): added to the history mip a reflection reads

ssr/use_prefiltered.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): glossy lobes read blurred mips of the previous frame (SEDX: the mip the lobe's footprint covers)

ssr/sample_count.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): rays per pixel (SEDX traces the mirror direction)

sedx/ssr_gloss_fade.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): gloss over which reflections fade in above ssr/min_gloss, so the edge to the probes doesn't show

sedx/ssr_max_steps.source: SEDX: hierarchical-Z iterations before a ray gives up (FidelityFX SSSR's max_traversal_intersections is 128)

sedx/ssr_thickness_m.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): how far behind the depth buffer's surface a hit still counts

sedx/ssr_thickness_ratio.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): plus this share of the hit's view depth (depth precision falls with distance)

sedx/ssr_edge_fade.source: SEDX: reflections fade out over this share of the screen height at its edges (FidelityFX SSSR's vignette)

sedx/ssr_history_clamp.source: SEDX: brightest pre-exposed luminance the reflection history keeps (about 10 EV over middle grey), so the sun disc doesn't glare in blurred mips (X-Plane 12.3.0 fixed 'glaring light blooms from SSR')

sedx/ssr_lobe_scale.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): the GGX lobe's half width as a tangent per unit alpha (half maximum of the reflected lobe: about 1.29 alpha), which sizes the history mip

water/F0.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): Fresnel reflectance of the water surface at normal incidence

water/gloss.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): the surface's own gloss (roughness 1 - 0.96875 gloss) before the waves' slope variance widens it (SEDX: added to the variance, ASSUMPTION)

water/turbidity.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20) (SEDX ASSUMPTION about its meaning: clarity distance = turbidity / (1 - the water map's alpha), meters)

water/turbidity/cutoff.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): ln(0.01): light left at the clarity distance

water/sea_floor_coef.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20) (SEDX ASSUMPTION about its meaning: share of the sea floor at the bathymetry's depth seen through the water; its lakes show none)

water/foam_bias.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): waves break where the Jacobian of their choppy displacement falls below this

water/foam_ratio.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20) (SEDX ASSUMPTION about its meaning: foam per unit of Jacobian below the bias)

water/foam_scale.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20) (meaning unknown; SEDX doesn't use it yet)

water/h_displace_lambda.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): choppiness, the horizontal displacement's scale

water/spectrum/fetch_lo_m.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): fetch at height_lo_m (SEDX ASSUMPTION: times fetch_multiplier, rising to fetch_hi_m at height_hi_m)

water/spectrum/height_no_swell_m.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): no swell at or below this height (SEDX ASSUMPTION: max_swell from height_swell_m up)

water/spectrum/spread_blend.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): 0 waves from every direction, 1 the directional spreading (Horvath 2015)

water/spectrum/short_waves_fade.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dump, 2026-10-20): waves shorter than about this many meters fade (exp(-(k l)^2))

sedx/water_cascade_size_0.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION; X-Plane's cascade sizes aren't exposed): meters across the first FFT cascade

sedx/water_cascade_min_cycles.source: SEDX: a smaller cascade starts at waves this many times across its tile; the larger one holds the longer ones

sedx/water_spectrum_depth_m.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): water depth the spectrum's dispersion and TMA factor assume

sedx/water_height_per_amplitude.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): significant wave height per meter of sim/weather/region/wave_amplitude

sedx/water_foam_decay.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): share of the foam that fades each second

sedx/water_floor_albedo_r.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): sea floor albedo under the floor decal (water/sea_floor_coef > 0 only)

sedx/water_floor_decal_m.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): meters one repeat of the sea floor decal (lib/g10/decals/water.dcl) covers

sedx/water_clarity_min_m.source: SEDX: clarity distance floor for a water map alpha near 1

sedx/water_shore_depth_m.source: SEDX: waves rise to full height over this floor depth, so shores stay put (the bathymetry under lakes is often only 1-2 m: a deeper fade shows the 64 m cells)

sedx/water_use_fetch.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): the DSF's per-vertex fetch ratio scales the waves (X-Plane 12.4.4's dsf/kill_fetch is 1, but its references show calm lakes mirroring their shores)

sedx/water_pond_wave_scale.source: SEDX (ASSUMPTION): wave height at fetch ratio 0 (a few hundred meters of fetch: about 0.09 m under a 1 m sea)

sedx/water_grid_m.source: SEDX: water meshes are cut into cells this size so tessellation has vertices where the camera is

sedx/water_tessellation_px.source: SEDX: target length of a tessellated water edge on screen (pixels)

sedx/sdr_night_slope_red.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): X-Plane's night grade (30 night shots, sun -10.6 deg and below), not an art control of its own

sedx/sdr_night_output_gain.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): color_management/sdr/output_gain at night

sedx/sdr_night_start_deg.source: ASSUMPTION: sun elevation where the night grade starts (the day grade still holds at 7.6 deg)

sedx/sdr_night_full_deg.source: ASSUMPTION: sun elevation where the night grade is complete (it holds at -10.6 deg)

sedx/sdr_snow_power_scale.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): with snow on the ground the day power is 0.9 x (1.44 / 1.44 / 1.5408)

sedx/sdr_snow_cover.source: ASSUMPTION: snow cover at which the snow grade is complete (cover 0.87 and 1 dump the same power)

sedx/tonemap_middle_grey.source: ASSUMPTION: the display transform's pivot; with exposure 18 / (K x 2^EV) a metered scene's average lands on it

sedx/fusion_strength.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): X-Plane's exposure_fusion/shadows reads 0.0001-0.011 in every daylight shot (about 2.5 x autoexposure/contrast_score) and 0.19 with snow, so its local tone mapping barely changes the frame; SEDX's fusion is off until it follows that adaptive amount

twxr/rain_area_scale.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): meters per repeat of the noise that patches wet ground (ASSUMPTION about the unit)

twxr/snow/scale_albedo.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): meters per repeat of snow_ALB (ASSUMPTION about the unit; scale_normal and scale_decal alike)

twxr/ice/scale_albedo.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): meters per repeat of ice_ALB (ASSUMPTION about the unit)

snow/luma_r.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): snow receptivity without a WEATHER mask = these weights . the linear albedo (r, g, b, a)

hack/petr/wxr/kf/rain_in_0.source: X-Plane 12.4.4 (reference probe dumps, 2026-10-25): keyframes turning an amount (in) into the threshold a receptivity must pass (out)

sedx/weather_water_gloss.source: ASSUMPTION: gloss of the water film on wet ground and in puddles (X-Plane takes it from its animated rain droplets texture, which SEDX does not make yet)
